title: Sleepovers Standard
summary: Sleepovers are a privilege. Therapists approved to stay overnight must treat the Spa as a professional workplace with responsibility, discipline, cleanliness, and respect for the team and premises.

sections.title: The Standard
paragraphs: A sleepover at Zura Spa refers to a therapist staying within the Spa premises beyond their normal working hours or overnight for an approved reason. Sleepovers are a privilege and must be handled with responsibility, discipline, and respect for the Spa environment.

Any therapist approved to sleep over is expected to understand that being permitted to stay does not mean the Spa becomes a personal residence. The premises must be treated as a professional workplace at all times.

sections.title: Therapist's Mindset Towards Sleepovers
paragraphs: Therapists should approach sleepovers with the mindset of responsibility, respect, cleanliness, and self-discipline.

A therapist should understand that their behaviour during a sleepover can affect the safety, cleanliness, reputation, and overall working environment of Zura Spa. Personal comfort should never come at the expense of the Spa's standards or other team members.
The right mindset is: "I have been given permission to stay, so I have a responsibility to protect and respect the space."

sections.title: What Therapists Should Do
list: Keep the sleeping and surrounding areas clean and organized.
Respect Spa property and handle all facilities carefully.
Keep noise at a reasonable level, especially during resting hours.
Respect the privacy and personal space of other therapists.
Follow any instructions or restrictions given by management.
Secure the premises properly and report any damage, fault, or unusual incident.
Dispose of waste properly and leave the area clean after use.
Use Spa facilities responsibly and only for their intended purpose.
Maintain professional conduct even outside active working hours.

sections.title: What Therapists Should Not Do
list: Do not invite friends, clients, partners, or unauthorized persons into the Spa for a sleepover.
Do not use the Spa premises as a venue for personal gatherings or entertainment.
Do not misuse Spa equipment, facilities, or supplies.
Do not leave the premises untidy for the next person.
Do not engage in behaviour that could compromise the professionalism or reputation of Zura Spa.
Do not disturb other therapists who are resting.
Do not take Spa property for personal use without authorization.
Do not assume that permission to sleep over gives unrestricted access to the premises.
Do not conceal damage, loss, misconduct, or any incident that occurs during the sleepover.

sections.title: Management Standard
paragraphs: Sleepovers must be approved by management and may be restricted or withdrawn if the privilege is abused. Any misconduct, damage, unauthorized guest, excessive noise, or repeated disregard for the rules may result in disciplinary action.
A sleepover is a privilege, not an entitlement. Respect the space, respect the team, and protect the Zura Spa standard.

remember: A sleepover is a privilege, not an entitlement. Respect the space, respect the team, and protect the Zura Spa standard.
